projects: The sidebar keeps local projects together. Select a project to open its workspace.
add-project: Use the + beside Projects to open an existing folder or create a new project.
move-project: Open the menu on Field Notes and select Studio as its group.
group: Field Notes is now in the Studio group, alongside its related projects.
overview: Inspect its files, architecture and contracts in Overview.
board: The board groups topics by status so you can see what is planned, active or finished.
launch-menu: Run stages with Pipeline, execute a build plan with Build, or show a web page with Demonstration.
choose-refinement: Choose the refinement pipeline from the project's pipeline catalog.
refinement: Check define, discover, specify and review, then launch the sample run.
run: This run uses simulated output to show the run tab. No real pipeline or container was started.
